framing.lineOfInquiry: Komal Thakur (P00159) may have been involved in the incident recorded in CASE004
framing.alternate: Komal Thakur (P00159) was not involved — the evidence has an innocent explanation
framing.note: KRONOS starts from the presumption of innocence. The line of inquiry and the alternates are tested against the same records; neither is a finding, and the strengths are not probabilities.

alternateHypotheses.title: Someone else used the phone or handset
alternateHypotheses.statement: Some records attributed to Komal Thakur were generated by another person using the same phone or handset.
alternateHypotheses.label: Strong

evidence.text: Handset IMEI-350167318826170 is also used by P00053 — another person may have generated some records
Shares a handset with P00053 but is a different person (household or shared device)

alternateHypotheses.test: Handset forensics and SIM CAF/KYC; establish who carried the handset at the incident time (the other user's location, CCTV).

alternateHypotheses.title: Named or given a role in error
alternateHypotheses.statement: Komal Thakur was named in the FIR, or assigned a role, without an independent basis.
alternateHypotheses.label: Moderate
alternateHypotheses.test: Re-examine the FIR and statements; record the person's statement and the informant's basis for naming them.

alternateHypotheses.title: The contact was routine, not coordination
alternateHypotheses.statement: Komal Thakur's calls and messages reflect a long-standing relationship (family, work, business), not planning of the incident.
alternateHypotheses.label: Moderate

alternateHypotheses.title: Was elsewhere at the time (alibi)
